title: Analyse movement across space and time
text: animovement “meta-package” analysing movement across space time. Whether data comes pose estimation, centroid tracking, trackball treadmill, analysis follows much arc: read data, check got, clean , put sensible frame reference, derive metrics care , look result. animovement ecosystem splits arc focused packages, one part well — animovement package bundles , single library(animovement) gives whole workflow versions conflicts sorted . includes core set packages loaded startup: aniframe provides core data structures rest ecosystem built — shared representation lets packages hand data one another. aniread reads writes movement data, turning output tracking tools recording hardware common structure. anicheck diagnoses data quality, find gaps, outliers low-confidence stretches reach results. aniprocess signal processing filtering — smoothing, interpolating otherwise cleaning trajectories. anispace handles spatial transformations, changing origin, rotating, converting coordinate systems. animetric calculates movement-based metrics, kinematics summary statistics. anivis visualises movement data diagnostics. Tutorials showing packages working together live animovement.dev; package’s function reference lives site, linked . page documents meta-package — attaching suite, tailoring , keeping date. work actively developers Python movement package reach similar data standards, workflows use cases; prefer analysing data Python, highly recommend using movement.
